captureAssessment.assessment: Both diagnostic Runs explicitly enabled no tools. captureRunInputs requires enabled read_file before inspecting workspace contents; the unavailable capture and rejected production export correctly preserve that boundary. Empty workspace contents are not authorization to inspect it. This is not an empty-workspace capture defect.

nextDesignRequirement: A lexical hit in one reviewed rule must not establish that other reviewed rules are irrelevant. Qualify recall over mixed-language and multi-rule requests before any screening policy promotion; keep the no-match fallback and general constraints, but neither alone resolves this observed partial-match regression.
